domain.program.name: Incident Escalation
domain.intake.purpose: Score incident severity, notify a pager service through a mock adapter, summarize remediation, and close.

artifacts.spec_yaml:
name: incident-escalation
termination: BoundedSession
topology: CyclicTopology
pure: true
preamble: |-
  Program: Incident Escalation. Score incident severity, notify a pager service through a mock adapter, summarize remediation, and close.

  This spec was synthesized mechanically by pgas-new.
initial: intake
terminal:
  - closed
features:
  - base
  - runtime_control
  - inline_world_query
  - reactions
channels:
  seed:
    direction: In
    sync: Async
  user_text:
    direction: In
    sync: Async
  system_mode_entry:
    direction: In
    sync: Async
  widget_output:
    direction: Out
    sync: Async
  stage_output:
    direction: Out
    sync: Sync
modes:
  intake:
    vocabulary:
      - begin_work
      - record_note
      - pin_note
      - unpin_note
      - delete_note
      - session_new
      - session_abort_current
      - session_status
      - session_history
      - session_resume
      - session_help
    channels:
      - user_text
      - seed
      - system_mode_entry
      - widget_output
    transitions:
      - target: severity_score
        guard:
          kind: FieldTruthy
          path: intake.started
  severity_score:
    vocabulary:
      - complete_severity_score
      - record_note
      - pin_note
      - unpin_note
      - delete_note
      - session_new
      - session_abort_current
      - session_status
      - session_history
      - session_resume
      - session_help
    channels:
      - user_text
      - widget_output
      - stage_output
    transitions:
      - target: pagerduty_adapter
        guard:
          kind: FieldTruthy
          path: severity_score.ready
  pagerduty_adapter:
    vocabulary:
      - complete_pagerduty_adapter
      - record_note
      - pin_note
      - unpin_note
      - delete_note
      - session_new
      - session_abort_current
      - session_status
      - session_history
      - session_resume
      - session_help
    channels:
      - user_text
      - widget_output
      - stage_output
    transitions:
      - target: remediation_summary
        guard:
          kind: FieldTruthy
          path: pagerduty_adapter.ready
  remediation_summary:
    vocabulary:
      - complete_remediation_summary
      - record_note
      - pin_note
      - unpin_note
      - delete_note
      - session_new
      - session_abort_current
      - session_status
      - session_history
      - session_resume
      - session_help
    channels:
      - user_text
      - widget_output
      - stage_output
    transitions:
      - target: closed
        guard:
          kind: FieldTruthy
          path: remediation_summary.done
  closed:
    vocabulary:
      - session_status
      - session_history
      - session_help
    channels:
      - widget_output
    transitions: []
proceed_to:
  begin_work: severity_score
  complete_severity_score: pagerduty_adapter
  complete_pagerduty_adapter: remediation_summary
  complete_remediation_summary: closed
projection:
  intake:
    include:
      - inputs.user_text
      - inputs.initial_user_text
      - notebook.*
      - notebook_pins
      - intake.started
    exclude: []
  closed:
    include:
      - inputs.initial_user_text
      - severity_score.ready
      - pagerduty_adapter.ready
      - remediation_summary.done
      - severity_score.output
      - pagerduty_adapter.output
      - remediation_summary.result_json
      - remediation_summary.items_json
      - remediation_summary.result
    exclude: []
  severity_score:
    include:
      - inputs.user_text
      - inputs.initial_user_text
      - notebook.*
      - notebook_pins
      - severity_score.ready
      - severity_score.output
    exclude: []
  pagerduty_adapter:
    include:
      - inputs.user_text
      - inputs.initial_user_text
      - notebook.*
      - notebook_pins
      - pagerduty_adapter.ready
      - severity_score.output
      - pagerduty_adapter.output
    exclude: []
  remediation_summary:
    include:
      - inputs.user_text
      - inputs.initial_user_text
      - notebook.*
      - notebook_pins
      - remediation_summary.done
      - severity_score.output
      - pagerduty_adapter.output
      - remediation_summary.result_json
      - remediation_summary.items_json
      - remediation_summary.result
    exclude: []
prompts:
  intake: |-
    Capture the initial request for Incident Escalation and start the work.
    Respond with EXACTLY ONE terminal action per response: call begin_work as the single native tool_call when this mode's work is ready. Valid terminal action JSON example: {"actions":[{"kind":"EffectAction","name":"begin_work","channel":"widget_output","payload":{}}]}. Emit exactly ONE such terminal action; do not emit raw MutationActions for a named action. Do not emit multiple tool_calls, empty action names, or free-form action JSON.
  closed: Terminal mode after Incident Escalation completion is confirmed.
  severity_score: |-
    Perform the severity_score stage for Incident Escalation.
    Respond with EXACTLY ONE terminal action per response: call complete_severity_score as the single native tool_call when this mode's work is ready. Valid terminal action JSON example: {"actions":[{"kind":"EffectAction","name":"complete_severity_score","channel":"stage_output","payload":{}}]}. Emit exactly ONE such terminal action; do not emit raw MutationActions for a named action. Do not emit multiple tool_calls, empty action names, or free-form action JSON.
  pagerduty_adapter: |-
    Perform the pagerduty_adapter stage for Incident Escalation.
    Respond with EXACTLY ONE terminal action per response: call complete_pagerduty_adapter as the single native tool_call when this mode's work is ready. Valid terminal action JSON example: {"actions":[{"kind":"EffectAction","name":"complete_pagerduty_adapter","channel":"stage_output","payload":{}}]}. Emit exactly ONE such terminal action; do not emit raw MutationActions for a named action. Do not emit multiple tool_calls, empty action names, or free-form action JSON.
  remediation_summary: |-
    You are performing the remediation_summary stage of Incident Escalation.
    Program purpose: Score incident severity, notify a pager service through a mock adapter, summarize remediation, and close.
    Ground your reasoning in the prior stage outputs available in program state: severity_score: severity_score.output.result_json, severity_score.output.items_json; pagerduty_adapter: pagerduty_adapter.output.result_json, pagerduty_adapter.output.items_json.
    Weigh the available evidence, reach an explicit judgment for this stage, and justify it concisely.
    Do not fabricate facts that are not present in the request or prior stage outputs.
    Return your reasoning through the stage action's arguments. result_json must be a JSON object containing at least: decision (enum: proceed | blocked), summary (string), rationale (string), confidence (enum: low | medium | high), key_points (string_array; pass the argument as a JSON array string). Additional keys are allowed. items_json must be a JSON array of strings matching: remediation_summary:decision:<decision>, remediation_summary:confidence:<confidence>.
    Respond with EXACTLY ONE terminal action per response: call complete_remediation_summary as the single native tool_call when this mode's work is ready. Valid terminal action JSON example: {"actions":[{"kind":"EffectAction","name":"complete_remediation_summary","channel":"stage_output","payload":{}}]}. Emit exactly ONE such terminal action; do not emit raw MutationActions for a named action. Do not emit multiple tool_calls, empty action names, or free-form action JSON.
ingestion:
  seed:
    - inputs.domain_context
    - inputs.domain_context.query
  user_text:
    - inputs.user_text
  system_mode_entry:
    - inputs.mode_entry
action_map:
  begin_work:
    description: Start intake and advance exactly one hop to severity_score.
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: intake.started
        value: true
    channel: widget_output
  record_note:
    description: Save or overwrite a working-memory note. Pass key and text.
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: notebook.*
        value: ''
        from_arg: '*'
    channel: widget_output
  pin_note:
    description: Pin a note so its full body stays visible in later rounds.
    arg_descriptions:
      key: The note key to pin.
    arg_schema:
      key:
        type: string
        required: true
    mutations:
      - op: MAppend
        path: notebook_pins
        value: ''
        from_arg: key
    channel: widget_output
  unpin_note:
    description: Unpin a previously pinned note.
    arg_descriptions:
      key: The note key to unpin.
    arg_schema:
      key:
        type: string
        required: true
    mutations:
      - op: MRemove
        path: notebook_pins
        value: ''
        from_arg: key
    channel: widget_output
  delete_note:
    description: Clear a working-memory note you no longer need. Pass key.
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: notebook.*
        value: ''
        from_arg: '*'
    channel: widget_output
  session_new:
    description: Control-plane new command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_new for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  session_abort_current:
    description: Control-plane abort current command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_abort_current for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  session_status:
    description: Control-plane status command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_status for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  session_history:
    description: Control-plane history command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_history for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  session_resume:
    description: Control-plane resume command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_resume for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  session_help:
    description: Control-plane help command. Session controls are for explicit control intent only; do not use session_help for normal stage progression.
    mutations: []
    channel: widget_output
  complete_severity_score:
    description: 'Run deterministic pure-compute wrapper for severity_score and advance exactly one hop to pagerduty_adapter. This is a deterministic wrapper: emit this action with an EMPTY payload. Do NOT author result_json, items_json, bytes, or any output fields; the wrapper computes and stores the result deterministically.'
    result_path: severity_score.output
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: severity_score.ready
        value: true
    channel: stage_output
  complete_pagerduty_adapter:
    description: 'Run deterministic external-adapter wrapper for pagerduty_adapter and advance exactly one hop to remediation_summary. This is a deterministic wrapper: emit this action with an EMPTY payload. Do NOT author result_json, items_json, bytes, or any output fields; the wrapper computes and stores the result deterministically.'
    result_path: pagerduty_adapter.output
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: pagerduty_adapter.ready
        value: true
    channel: stage_output
  complete_remediation_summary:
    description: Record runtime LLM reasoning output for remediation_summary and advance exactly one hop to closed. The generated handler accepts result_json as either a native JSON object or a JSON string, and items_json as either a native JSON array or a JSON string; it canonicalizes both into JSON strings at the stage output path.
    arg_descriptions:
      result_json: 'Optional tolerant result for the remediation_summary LLM reasoning stage. May be a native JSON object or a JSON string encoding an object containing at least: decision (enum: proceed | blocked), summary (string), rationale (string), confidence (enum: low | medium | high), key_points (string_array; pass the argument as a JSON array string). Additional keys are allowed.'
      items_json: 'Optional tolerant item list produced by the remediation_summary LLM reasoning stage. May be a native JSON array or a JSON string array matching the templates: remediation_summary:decision:<decision>, remediation_summary:confidence:<confidence>.'
      decision: 'The explicit judgment reached by the remediation_summary stage. One of: proceed | blocked. One of: proceed | blocked.'
      summary: One-paragraph summary of the remediation_summary judgment.
      rationale: Concise justification for the remediation_summary judgment, grounded in the request and prior stage outputs.
      confidence: 'Confidence in the judgment. One of: low | medium | high. One of: low | medium | high.'
      key_points: Key evidence points supporting the remediation_summary judgment. Provide the value as a JSON array string.
    arg_schema:
      decision:
        enum:
          - proceed
          - blocked
        type: string
        required: true
      summary:
        type: string
        required: true
      rationale:
        type: string
        required: true
      confidence:
        enum:
          - low
          - medium
          - high
        type: string
        required: true
      key_points:
        type: string
        required: true
    result_path: remediation_summary.output
    mutations:
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.done
        value: true
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_json
        value: {}
        from_arg: result_json
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_items_json
        value: []
        from_arg: items_json
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.decision
        from_arg: decision
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.summary
        from_arg: summary
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.rationale
        from_arg: rationale
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.confidence
        from_arg: confidence
      - op: MSet
        path: remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.key_points
        from_arg: key_points
    channel: stage_output

control_plane:
  version: 1
  session:
    program: incident-escalation
    binding: identity_channel_program
    concurrency:
      policy: single_active
      on_busy: reject_with_status
  free_text:
    control: ask
    bind:
      query: $text
  controls:
    ask:
      title: Ask
      aliases:
        - /ask
      args:
        query:
          type: string
          required: true
          capture: rest
      dispatch:
        - op: create_session
          as: session
          program: incident-escalation
        - op: trigger
          session: $session.id
          channel: user_text
          payload: $args.query
          mode: async
    abort:
      title: Abort run
      aliases:
        - /abort
        - /stop
      availability:
        when: active_session.running
      dispatch:
        - op: abort_session
          session: $active_session.id
      presentation:
        priority: destructive
        confirm: true
    new:
      title: New session
      aliases:
        - /new
        - /reset
        - /restart
      dispatch:
        - op: create_session
          as: session
          program: incident-escalation
      presentation:
        priority: secondary
    history:
      title: Recent sessions
      aliases:
        - /history
        - /recent
      dispatch:
        - op: list_sessions
          as: sessions
      presentation:
        priority: secondary
    status:
      title: Status
      aliases:
        - /status
      availability:
        when: active_session
      dispatch:
        - op: render_session
          session: $active_session.id
          view: status
      presentation:
        priority: contextual
    resume:
      title: Resume
      aliases:
        - /resume
      availability:
        when: active_session
      dispatch:
        - op: send_runtime_control
          session: $active_session.id
          control: resume
      presentation:
        priority: contextual
    help:
      title: Help
      aliases:
        - /help
      dispatch:
        - op: render_help
      presentation:
        priority: secondary
reactions:
  capture_initial_entry_input:
    event: AfterIngestion
    watch:
      - inputs.user_text
    write_scope:
      - inputs.initial_user_text
  mirror_remediation_summary_output:
    event: AfterRound
    write_scope:
      - remediation_summary.result_json
      - remediation_summary.items_json
  mirror_remediation_summary_result_fields:
    event: AfterMutation
    watch:
      - remediation_summary.output
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_json
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.decision
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.summary
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.rationale
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.confidence
      - remediation_summary.raw_result_fields.key_points
    write_scope:
      - remediation_summary.result.decision
      - remediation_summary.result.summary
      - remediation_summary.result.rationale
      - remediation_summary.result.confidence
      - remediation_summary.result.key_points
